subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should the Control UI solve this by raising the default batch size, by adding offset-based load-more pagination, or by exposing a supported history-depth setting?
rationale: The source confirms the 100-message cap, but the issue lists multiple acceptable product shapes with different performance and UX tradeoffs, and the linked PR only implements the larger fixed batch option.

options.title: Prefer offset pagination
options.body: Add a visible load-more or scroll-to-top path that fetches older messages through chat.history offset while keeping startup cost bounded.

options.title: Accept larger fixed batch
options.body: Land or adapt the linked PR if maintainers decide a 500-message startup batch is the intended near-term behavior.

options.title: Make history depth configurable
options.body: Add a supported config surface only if maintainers want users to trade startup cost against history depth explicitly.

recommendation.title: Prefer offset pagination
recommendation.body: Add a visible load-more or scroll-to-top path that fetches older messages through chat.history offset while keeping startup cost bounded.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available routing candidate from recent Control UI chat-history source history.
